title: Person: Mrs Riordan
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mrs Riordan

anchor.prefix:
old Christy, he’s nearly lopsided now with roguery.

 —Simon, said Mrs Dedalus, you haven’t given Mrs Riordan any sauce.

 Mr Dedalus seized the sauceboat.

 —Haven’t I? he cried.
anchor.suffix:
, pity the poor blind.

 Dante covered her plate with her hands and said:

 —No, thanks.

 Mr Dedalus turned to uncle Charles.

 —How are you off, sir?

 —Right as the mail, Simon.
